page.overview:
What is Undella Town?

Undella Town is a large resort town in eastern Unova. To the east of the town is Undella Bay, where you can access an underwater temple known as the Abyssal Ruins. Undella Town is also home to Unova's famous underwater Marine Tube that serves as a bridge between the town and Humilau City}}.

Cynthia also often visits the town and stays in her friend's (Caitlin) villa where she can be battled in the Spring and Summer.

In this town, you can also sell any items you might find during your exploration in the Abyssal Ruins to a collector residing in the Riches' house in the west, where the two younger 'Rich' children battle you once per day.

There are various Pokémon throughout the area, which can be obtained by fishing or surfing. The encounter level will range from 25 to 70. Also, in summer, a woman in a villa offers to trade her Munchlax for a Cinccino.
